about: The graduale of the formulary “14th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: It is good to trust in the Lord, rather than to trust in man. It is good to hope in the Lord, rather than to hope in princes.

nt.w001: “Bonum” is positive in form, but with “quam” it expresses a comparison here: “better … than …”.
